work.name: TextNow, Infrastructure Engineering (SRE)
work.summary: Monitoring, CI reliability, and cost optimization on AWS/EKS infrastructure.
highlights: Instrumented IPv6 neighbor-table capacity and overflow in Datadog with leading-indicator and incident-signature monitors, detecting a previously unmonitored DNS failure mode.
Traced CI runner failures to AWS Auto Scaling AZ Rebalance and moved EKS node groups to a single Availability Zone.
Right-sized EC2 CI runners from fleet telemetry, for a projected 33.3% annualized cost saving (about $48K).
Built Go/Python workflows on AWS AgentCore and EKS to triage requests and draft Terraform changes.

work.name: University of Waterloo Computer Science Club
work.summary: Run the club's Linux servers, core services, and public software mirror.
highlights: Maintain Linux servers and DNS, Kerberos, LDAP, NFS, and Prometheus/Munin services.
Operate the CS Club mirror (ZFS, Go-based sync, rsync/nginx); supported the CloudStack-to-Proxmox VE migration.

projects.name: RDMA & Datacenter Networking Homelab
highlights: Configured and benchmarked RoCEv2 and InfiniBand RDMA throughput using ib_write_bw and ib_read_bw.
Explored Priority Flow Control and Explicit Congestion Notification for datacenter congestion management.

projects.name: Codex Homelab Controller
highlights: Built a Go control plane that schedules concurrent Proxmox LXC workers through K3s/Kueue, with durable SQLite state and restart reconciliation to prevent duplicate dispatch.

projects.name: Lacs Language Compiler
highlights: Implemented a Lacs-to-MIPS compiler with DFA scanning, CYK parsing, lexical scoping, and IR lowering.
Built MIPS code generation and a stack/heap runtime with tail calls and Cheney copying garbage collection.
